Definition: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
BiblicalUsage: This is the word for who, which, what and that, the little word that joins one clause to the next, and it is used thousands of times. God saw every thing that He had made, and behold, it was very good, and the LORD says, I am the LORD thy God, which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt.
TheologicalSignificance: One small joining word carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is that the whole Bible hangs on it, that God made all that He made, and that He brought His people out of Egypt.
